space.$description: 4px grid in px. Padding, margin and gap use only these steps; a value between two steps rounds up, so controls never get smaller. Browser zoom scales px, so spacing needs no rem.

5.$description: Paragraph spacing in case studies, grid gaps.

16.$description: Large blocks, e.g. the next-project block.

30.$description: Hero top padding. The largest fixed step.

gutter.$description: Page side padding: 16px on a 390px screen to 48px at 1280px. Never below 16px, so content still reflows at 320px (WCAG 1.4.10).

section.$description: Vertical padding of page sections: 64px on a 390px screen to 120px at 1280px.

sm.$description: Small inline blocks: pull quotes, metrics, pain points. Never buttons.

lg.$description: Every card (text and image), images, banners and modals.

pill.$description: Every button, tag and chip. No square buttons.

round.$description: Circles: dots, avatars, round icon buttons.

ring-width.$description: Width of the keyboard focus ring. Focus is always this ring in color-focus, never a shadow.

ring-offset.$description: Gap between an element and its focus ring.
